Listing cards for sign-off

Every service's results, redrawn in Gratifi's own cards. Flights and stays follow Tripsure's layout; every other service follows the two leaders in its category. The information and order come from them; the look stays ours. These are screenshots of the working app, in English and Arabic.

FlightsFlight timelinePrice breakupFaresStaysDiningExperiencesEventsRides, rail and car hireCar hireCoach or busShopping

Flights

Format from Tripsure, Google Flights, Skyscanner

  • The search on top: route, dates, travellers, cabin (Tripsure)
  • Best, Cheapest and Fastest, each with its price and time (Skyscanner)
  • Each flight as a card: airline, departure and arrival with airports, time in the air on a line with the stop marked (Tripsure, Google Flights)
  • Tap the stops for the timeline; tap the price for what it is made of (Tripsure)
  • Price for everyone travelling, with the fare's best perk as a tick

Flight timeline

Format from Tripsure

  • Every stop with its time, airport and terminal
  • Each flight with airline and number
  • The change of planes picked out, longer waits called a long layover

Price breakup

Format from Tripsure

  • Base fare, taxes and airport fees, booking fee (none)
  • The total in money and points

Fares

Format from Tripsure and the airlines

  • Each fare with what it includes, ticked
  • What changing or cancelling costs, with the fee in money
  • The return flight to pick, then one button

Stays

Format from Tripsure, Booking.com, Expedia

  • The search on top: city, dates, rooms, guests (Tripsure)
  • Quick filters that work on the spot: free cancellation, breakfast, price, star rating (Tripsure, Booking.com)
  • Every hotel as a picture card (Tripsure)
  • Stars, score with reviews, area and distance, room, ticked facts, rooms left (Booking.com, Expedia)
  • Price for the whole stay, with nights and guests, taxes included

Dining

Format from OpenTable, TheFork

  • Score, word and reviews
  • Cuisine and price band
  • Card offer in orange
  • The tables still free, as buttons that open the booking at that time (OpenTable)
  • How many times it was booked today

Experiences

Format from GetYourGuide, Viator

  • Score and reviews
  • Duration and group size
  • Free cancellation ticked; "Likely to sell out" in amber
  • "From" price per person

Events

Format from Ticketmaster, StubHub

  • Date first, then venue
  • Presale for cardholders in orange; "Selling fast" in amber when an area is sold out
  • "From" price per ticket

Rides, rail and car hire

Format from Uber, Lyft · Trainline, Omio · Rentalcars.com

  • Rides: minutes away and seats, fixed price, cancel-until-the-driver-arrives ticked
  • Trains and coaches: the next departures and the e-ticket
  • Car hire: "or similar", seats, bags, gearbox and air con, mileage and fuel policy, free cancellation, price per day

Car hire, on its own

Format from Rentalcars.com, Expedia

  • The same card when car hire is asked for directly

Coach or bus

Format from Trainline, Omio

  • A single result opens straight on the booking card, as before

Shopping

Format from Amazon, Walmart

  • Score, word and reviews
  • Seller
  • Delivery date ticked, free returns
  • Price, then View
Status: these are going live once the full test run passes in all 7 markets. Tell me any card to change and how. Data shown is mocked, as across the demo.
